_comment: Position-anchor gap while disengaging: team 0's Infantry gets a plain move order (no attack target) straight through team 1's held Infantry. Team 0 stays a disengage the whole time -- never is_engaged(), never strikes back -- but team 1 is only on Hold (never chases, still defends where it stands), so it attacks team 0 one-sidedly once in range; team 0 takes real casualties, identically on main and on this fix (the casualty formula is unaffected -- only the geometry differs). Before the fix, SoldierBodies.couple() still anchored team 0's own position on the whole-block centroid (empty position_anchor_indices(), since team 0 never is_engaged()), so its kinematic advance dragged the block's slot grid straight through and past the contact-resisted bodies. After the fix, position anchors on the real contact-resisted front ranks, so the block's own advance genuinely arrests at contact instead of riding through.
